content: After teasing the series with some first-look images yesterday, Amazon is finally properly unveiling its Blade Runner streaming series. Called Blade Runner 2099, the show hits Prime Video on November 25th with all eight episodes dropping at once. We also got the first trailer for the series, which is full of Blade Runner staples: a bleak futuristic LA, dramatic narration, and some really good coats. The show is helmed by Silka Luisa, previously showrunner on Apple TV’s adaptation of Shining Girls, while original Blade Runner director Ridley Scott is signed on as an executive producer. 2099 stars Michelle Yeoh and Hunter Schafer and, as the name implies, takes place a few decades after Denis Villeneuve’s film Blade Runner 2049. Here’s the official premise: > Fifty years after the events of Blade Runner 2049, Los Angeles has been reborn, just not by humanity. Cora, a fugitive in a final bid to stop running, takes on one last identity: a Blade Runner. Forced to partner with Olwen, a Replicant days from dying, she hunts down a runaway hiding a truth that could collapse their fragile city. [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/07/Blade_Runner_2099_Michelle_as_Olwen_3000.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/07/Blade_Runner_2099_Hunter_as_Cora_3000.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] It’s been a long time coming for Blade Runner 2099, as Amazon first revealed it was working on the series back in 2022. But it’s coming at what could be a good time for cyberpunk television, as Apple is also working up an adaptation of William Gibson’s Neuromancer.

chineseContent: 在昨天用一些先睹为快的图片来预告该系列之后，亚马逊终于正确地推出了其《银翼杀手》流媒体系列。该剧名为《银翼杀手 2099》，于 11 月 25 日登陆 Prime Video，全部八集同时下架。我们还得到了该系列的第一部预告片，其中充满了《银翼杀手》的主要内容：荒凉的未来洛杉矶、戏剧性的旁白和一些非常好的外套。该剧由西尔卡·路易莎 (Silka Luisa) 执导，她曾担任 Apple TV 改编版《闪亮女孩》的剧集主管，而《银翼杀手》原版导演雷德利·斯科特 (Ridley Scott) 则签约担任执行制片人。 《2099》由杨紫琼和亨特·谢弗主演，顾名思义，故事发生在丹尼斯·维伦纽瓦的电影《银翼杀手 2049》几十年后。官方设定如下： > 《银翼杀手 2049》事件发生五十年后，洛杉矶重生了，只不过不是人类重生了。科拉是一名逃亡者，为了停止逃跑而做出了最后的努力，她承担了最后一个身份：银翼杀手。她被迫与濒临死亡的复制人奥尔文合作，追捕一名逃亡者，隐瞒了一个可能会摧毁他们脆弱城市的真相。 [图片：https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/07/Blade_Runner_2099_Michelle_as_Olwen_3000.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [图片： https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/07/Blade_Runner_2099_Hunter_as_Cora_3000.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] 《银翼杀手 2099》已经等了很长时间了，亚马逊早在 2022 年就首次透露正在制作该系列。赛博朋克电视，苹果公司也在制作威廉·吉布森的《神经漫游者》的改编版。
